run_config.anomaly_map: upstream dists2map(patch_grid, original_rgb.shape): cv2 bilinear to native size + gaussian sigma 4; float32; no downsampling, no min-max
run_config.model_loading: torch.hub local dinov2 repo, pretrained=False, strict state_dict load
run_config.timing_scope: per image predict_one: imread + upstream prepare_image + DINOv2 forward + PCA mask + 1-NN + mean_top1p + dists2map to native size, with cuda synchronize; excludes bank build (bank_build_seconds), map file writing and metric evaluation
run_config.bank_build_scope: read + 8 rotations + DINOv2 forward for every reference + 1-NN index upload; after warm-up, no cached features

calibration_usage: 20 normal images for threshold only; no training or reference bank

resources.peak_scope: calibration + test predict_one calls; bank stays resident and is included
resources.timing_includes: predict_one call and optional device synchronization
resources.timing_excludes: bank construction, calibration, map file writing, metric evaluation
